text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire writes a reply to a fan letter.
Upon closer inspection, however—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—To you, who face the tournament with a strong heart,
I bestow this single kanji.
choice_data_list: What's that written at the end of the letter?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. These are runes.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I have been thinking for some time now about a saintly return gift
for those who send me letters.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That's when I thought of runes.
Even a single character
holds so many different meanings, after all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: For those working hard in sports, or struggling with relationships, and so forth. I choose words tailored to each person as a small token of gratitude.
choice_data_list: I see, that's a wonderful gesture.
I see, that's a wonderful gesture.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, when I think of all the fans,
this is the least I can do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later, when I went out shopping with Red Desire—

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Um, Desire-san...!
I-I'm the one who received a reply
to my fan letter the other day!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My! Thank you so much for your support.
Both your letters and words of encouragement
are always such a huge boost—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Oh? That keychain is...?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is... the runic script
Desire-san wrote for me.
I made it by hand to serve as a charm...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so!
—I pray that the sacred text guides your path.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Um, actually, I already found guidance. Showing this
to a classmate was how we became friends in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
I had such a hard time making friends...
I'm so glad I consulted with you, Desire-san!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. It seems you truly had heaven's divine blessing on your side.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "However, above all else, I am truly happy that you were able to move forward on your own two feet."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let me give you this as a celebration.
This character should be what you need right now.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Um, what does this text say...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This represents trust.
It's the single most vital thing connecting people together.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I put my heartfelt wish into this,
that the brilliance you have obtained will last forever.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
May fortune favor your courage
for taking this step forward of your own free will.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Desire-san... thank you very much.
Ah, you truly are like a saint...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but be impressed by fan service
that was uniquely Red Desire's style.
